title: Show hours in a duration label
task: formatDuration in src/duration.js labels 3725 seconds as '62m 5s'. Add hours: from 3,600 seconds the label shows hours, minutes and seconds ('1h 2m 5s'; 7200 is '2h 0m 0s'), and below an hour it stays as it is. The acceptance tests are in test/duration.test.js (node --test); do not change them. The package has no dependencies: install nothing.
